payout_quote: GICU official site navigation lists the account as Greater Checking $400 (gicu.org). Official disclosure (gicu.org Greater Checking Bonus 2026 Disclosure PDF): Bonus Requirements: 1. Open a new Greater Checking Account. 2. Within the first 60 days (qualification period) after account opening: a. Enroll in estatements b. Have one direct deposit of at least $100 c. Make at least 20 debit card purchases totaling at least $100 that post and settle within 60 days of opening the account. Bonus Payment: Once the 60-day qualification period has elapsed, we will determine if you have met the Bonus Requirements. If Bonus Requirements are met, we will deposit the earned bonus into your Primary Share account within 60 days. You are not eligible for this bonus offer if you are a current owner of any Greater Iowa Credit Union checking account or have owned a Greater Iowa Credit Union checking account within the last 180 days of opening the new Greater Checking. There is a limit of one bonus per member. You are responsible for any federal, state, or local taxes due on the bonus, and we will report it as income as required by applicable tax law. Minimum opening deposit ($50) required.
steps: Confirm Greater Iowa Credit Union membership eligibility (live, work, worship, or attend school in one of its 33 Iowa counties).
Open a new Greater Checking account with the $50 minimum opening deposit.
Within the first 60 days: enroll in eStatements, receive at least one direct deposit of $100 or more, and make at least 20 debit card purchases totaling at least $100 that post and settle.
Keep the account open; the $400 bonus is deposited to the Primary Share account within 60 days after the qualification period.
catches: Requires 20 debit card purchases totaling $100+ within 60 days - high transaction count.
Not eligible if you currently own or have owned a Greater Iowa CU checking account within the last 180 days.
Bonus paid up to 60 days after the 60-day qualification period - slow payout (up to ~4 months).
Membership limited to 33-county Iowa field of membership.
Limited-time offer; can be changed or discontinued at any time.
biggest_catch: Twenty debit card purchases totaling $100+ within 60 days plus a $100+ direct deposit is real activity, and payout takes up to 60 days after the qualification period ends.
eligibility: New Greater Checking members in Greater Iowa CU's 33-county Iowa field of membership; no current or recent (180 days) Greater Iowa CU checking ownership; one bonus per member.
timing: Bonus deposited to the Primary Share account within 60 days after the 60-day qualification period, if requirements are met.
